core.policies.title: Policies
core.policies.description: How we look after your data, and the terms and rules that apply when you use this site or visit us.
core.policies.not-found: There is no policy at this address.
core.settings.organisation.company-numbe: Quoted in the policies if the theatre is a registered company.
core.settings.organisation.law.label: Governing law
core.settings.organisation.law.help: The law the terms are read under, in words, such as England and Wales or Scotland. Quoted in the policies.
core.settings.complaints.reply-within.he: The time the policies promise for a reply to a complaint or an accessibility problem.
core.settings.visiting.latecomers.label: Latecomers, usually
core.settings.visiting.latecomers.help: What usually happens to someone who arrives after the start. The house rules explain all four, since each show can differ.
core.settings.visiting.latecomers.option: Let in at a suitable point (front of house decide)
core.settings.visiting.accompanied-under: Children come with an adult if under
The age below which the house rules ask for an adult to stay with a child. 0 leaves the rule out.
core.settings.visiting.recording-allowed: Off, the house rules forbid photographs and recording. On, they allow photographs without flash.
core.settings.privacy.registration-numbe: The reference the data protection regulator gave you (in the UK, your ICO registration). Quoted in the privacy notice.
core.settings.privacy.data-location.help: In words, such as the European Union. Quoted in the privacy notice; left empty, the notice does not name a place.
core.settings.accounts.minimum-age.label: Youngest age for an account
core.settings.accounts.minimum-age.help: Stated in the terms of use and the privacy notice. It is not checked when someone signs up.
core.policies.versions.title: {policy}: versions
core.policies.versions.description: Each version of this policy that has been in force, newest first.
core.policies.versions.none: No version has been recorded yet.
core.policies.versions.old: This is how the policy read at the time. It may have changed since.
core.settings.policies.reviewed.label: Policies that have been reviewed
core.settings.policies.reviewed.help: The policies whose text a competent person has read for your theatre, by the last part of each address: privacy, terms, accessibility, visiting, tickets. Site readiness lists the rest.
